urlTemplate.description:
URL of the page that lists the chapters. `{url}` is the series URL; the named groups of
string? SelectorDownloaderSettings.SeriesUrlPattern are available too, e.g.
`https://example.com/series/{id}/chapters`.

url.description: The chapter's link, relative to the chapter item.

number.description:
The chapter number, relative to the chapter item. When unused the item's text is searched. The first number
in the extracted text is used (`Chapter 12.5` becomes `12.5`); chapters without one are skipped.

dateFormat.description: Optional .NET date format for SelectorField ChaptersSpec.Date (e.g. `yyyy-MM-dd`); ISO 8601 and common formats are tried without it.

nextPage.description: Optional link to the next page of the chapter list (followed up to 50 times).

ChaptersSpec.description: How to list the chapters of a series.

branch.description: Git branch the build was produced from.

version.description: SemVer derived from the nearest git tag and commit count.

commitDate.description: Timestamp of the commit the build was produced from.

isDirty.description: Whether the working tree had uncommitted changes at build time.

GitInfoResponse.description: Build commit/version/branch info for this service, sourced from devlooped/GitInfo at build time.

urlTemplate.description: URL of the page that shows the images. `{url}` is the chapter URL, e.g. `{url}/images`.

imageSelector.description: Selects one element per page image, in reading order.

attribute.description: Attribute holding the image URL. Defaults to `data-src,data-lazy-src,src`.

pageSelector.description:
Only for sites that show one image per HTML page: selects the links (or the options of a page dropdown) that
lead to each page of the chapter, in reading order. The attribute defaults to `href,value`. Every page
found is then fetched and the image selector is applied to it. The chapter page itself is not fetched twice
when it is one of the pages. When the selector finds nothing, the image selector is applied to the chapter
page, as if this was not set.

ImagesSpec.description: How to find the pages of a chapter.

urlTemplate.description:
URL of the search results. `{query}` is replaced with the URL-encoded search text and `{page}` with the
page number (always 1). Relative URLs are resolved against the base URL, e.g.
`/search/data?text={query}&limit=32`.

itemSelector.description: Selects one element per search result (the same selector may also match the result's link).

title.description: The series title, relative to the result item.

url.description: Link to the series page, relative to the result item. Relative links are resolved.

cover.description: The cover image URL, relative to the result item.

SearchSpec.description: How to find series on the website.

chapters.description: How to list the chapters of a series.

images.description: How to find the pages of a chapter.

id.description: Becomes Guid IExtension.Identifier. Persisted on download links, so it must never change. Assigned by the server.

baseUrl.description: Root of the website, e.g. `https://weebcentral.com`. Relative URLs are resolved against it.

iconUrl.description: Optional icon, defaults to the website's favicon.

languages.description: Languages the website publishes in (e.g. `en`). A search in another language finds nothing.

useFlareSolverr.description: Route requests through the configured FlareSolverr instance (for Cloudflare protected sites).

requestsPerSecond.description: Requests per second to the website itself (0.1 - 20). Image CDNs on other hosts are limited separately.

headers.description: Extra request headers, e.g. a cookie or a User-Agent.

seriesUrlPattern.description:
Optional regular expression that a series URL has to match. Its named groups (e.g. `(?<id>[^/]+)`) are
available as `{id}` in string ChaptersSpec.UrlTemplate for sites whose chapter list lives at a
different URL than the series page.

SelectorDownloaderDefinition.description:
Describes a user-defined download source that is driven entirely by CSS/XPath selectors, so that people can add a
website to Tranga without writing code: the SelectorDownloaderSettings of the website plus how to
search, list chapters and find the pages. Turned into an IDownloadExtension by
SelectorDownloadExtension; persisted as one JSON document. A definition is always validated as a whole;
to try a single step without the others, use the settings and that step's section on their own.

id.description: Becomes Guid IExtension.Identifier. Persisted on download links, so it must never change. Assigned by the server.

baseUrl.description: Root of the website, e.g. `https://weebcentral.com`. Relative URLs are resolved against it.

iconUrl.description: Optional icon, defaults to the website's favicon.

languages.description: Languages the website publishes in (e.g. `en`). A search in another language finds nothing.

useFlareSolverr.description: Route requests through the configured FlareSolverr instance (for Cloudflare protected sites).

requestsPerSecond.description: Requests per second to the website itself (0.1 - 20). Image CDNs on other hosts are limited separately.

headers.description: Extra request headers, e.g. a cookie or a User-Agent.

seriesUrlPattern.description:
Optional regular expression that a series URL has to match. Its named groups (e.g. `(?<id>[^/]+)`) are
available as `{id}` in string ChaptersSpec.UrlTemplate for sites whose chapter list lives at a
different URL than the series page.

SelectorDownloaderSettings.description:
The general settings of a user-defined download source (the website itself, not how to scrape it). They validate
themselves (IValidatableObject), so whoever receives one - an API endpoint, the test of a single step,
the engine - does not have to know the rules.

selector.description:
CSS selector or XPath expression (XPath when it starts with `/`, `./`, `../` or `(`).
An XPath may end in `/@attribute` or `/text()`.

attribute.description:
Attribute to read, e.g. `href`. A comma separated list (`srcset,src`) is tried in order and the first
non-empty value wins. Empty reads the element's text.

regex.description:
Regular expression applied to the value. Without string? SelectorField.Replacement the first capture group (or the
whole match) is kept; a value that does not match counts as missing.

replacement.description: When set, string? SelectorField.Regex replaces every match with this text instead of extracting.

SelectorField.description:
Extracts one value from an HTML element: string SelectorField.Selector picks the element (relative to the item the field
belongs to; empty = the item itself), string? SelectorField.Attribute picks what to read (empty = the element's text), and
the optional string? SelectorField.Regex post-processes the result.

requestUrl.description: The URL that was requested, once the template has been filled in.

statusCode.description: HTTP status of the response, when there was one.

itemCount.description: How many items (search results, chapters, images) were extracted in total.

rows.description: The first extracted items, one dictionary of field name to value each.

warnings.description: Things that probably are not what the user wants (selector matched nothing, fields missing, ...).

error.description: Why the step failed, if it did.

StepTestResult.description:
What one step of a source definition produced against the real website, so users can fix their selectors before
saving the source.
